about_the_game:
In the endless sky, small islands float, and people make their homes upon them.

On one of these tiny floating isles live a girl and a bird.

The girl is Annie—she loves researching relics and tinkering with gadgets—and the bird is Tristan, her plump, round partner.

They earn their living as “Re-collector” retrieving relics from the crumbling ruins of　Worseth.

Their goal is simple: to upgrade their base and fly freely through the skies.

They return to Worseth once again, working on base upgrades and funding their base.

Aiming to recover ever rarer, ever more valuable relics—your treasures.

 

 

The adventure isn’t over until you bring the treasures back—a tense and challenging 2D platformer.

Explore the ruins, escape the collapsing tower, and return with your treasures.

But if you’re caught in the collapse, it’s game over—and everything is lost.

 

Recovering treasures isn’t easy! Sometimes, giving up is the smart move.

Gathering treasures takes time, and with the ruins always crumbling, you may need to leave them behind and make your escape.

 

 

Keep exploring, or make your escape—

The ruins are built in layers, and at the top of each floor you must choose: climb higher or get out.

You can only escape from the top of a floor, and once you move on, you won’t be able to leave until you reach the top of the next floor.

Will you risk climbing further, or escape with the relics you’ve secured?

 

 

Escape difficulty increases with the amount of treasures you carry.

Outside the ruins, you must reach the exit before the tower collapses.

Your time limit shortens as you gather more treasures.

Don’t just grab everything—decide what to take and how much you can actually carry out.

 

 

Use the treasures you bring back to upgrade your base!

Treasures you return with come in two types: those sold for money, and treasures kept as keepsakes.

With money and relics, you can expand your base, unlock higher difficulties, and strengthen your abilities.

Make exploration and escape easier—and aim to bring back even rarer treasures!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64bit)
  • Processor: Intel i5-4590 equivalent or greater
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX660 equivalent or greater
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Sound Card: Windows compatible sound card

short_description: Join Annie and Tristan, the Re-collector, in the collapsing tower “Worseth” to retrieve treasures. Will you keep exploring, or make your escape? Make the best choices if you want to bring back more treasures!
